findings.title: The 'B2-era' generation descriptor doesn't match the real archives it tells the implementer to pin from
findings.recommendation: The scenario characterizes the first generation as 'kind + findings_summary, EMPTY findings[], no scorecard' and mandates fixtures from the real archives — empirically the actual B2 emits have NO findings key at all; the kind+findings_summary generation persisted through B3→mid-D2 with POPULATED (dimension-less) findings; the only real empty-findings emits of that generation are C1/C2/D1 clean passes. Also task 1.4 labels the no-kind shape 'pre-D3' while it began mid-D2-cycle (the spec's own label is 'D3-cycle'). Detection is unaffected (the requirement keys on kind+findings_summary/no-scorecard). Describe the first generation by its detection keys with 'findings[] absent, empty, or dimension-less' (or name the archives per variant), and fix task 1.4's 'pre-D3' → 'D3-cycle'.

findings.title: The address-side copy of the external findings format still carries the pre-D4 Notes placeholder
findings.recommendation: address' references/external-findings-format.md renders the same ## Notes slot as '<Optional: overall impression, broader concerns.>' while the change rewrites that placeholder at the prompt-template source; no task touches this file. Post-apply two shipped docs describing one format disagree — the exact cross-doc drift audit-drift Cat 3 flags. Extend task 3.4 (or 3.5) to update the Notes line in address' external-findings-format reference to the Commentary-contract text or a one-line pointer to the prompt template as the format's source of truth.

findings.title: The internal strict-validation checked set omits reviewer_class and depth, which the header consumes

commentary: The cadence's asymptote is visible: the independent slot's findings have gone 5C → 7C → 2C → 0C with this pass's four findings all descriptor- or reference-copy-level — nothing touches the design's load-bearing decisions anymore. The two WARNINGs share a genre worth naming for D5: SHIPPED REFERENCE COPIES (the address-side format doc) and ARCHIVE DESCRIPTORS (which generation had which fields) are both places where prose duplicates a source of truth that lives elsewhere — the same disease the renderer cures for reports.
